on_screen_text.text: NOW: PRESIDENT TRUMP MAKES APPEARANCE IN YANKEES CLUBHOUSE
SHOOTING AT TAMPA APARTMENT COMPLEX LEAVES TEENAGER DEAD, 5 OTHERS WOUNDED

spoken_summary: Donald Trump addresses the New York Yankees in their clubhouse, telling them they are going to win. He reminisces about his friendship with the late owner George Steinbrenner and tells an anecdote about how the Yankees would always win when he attended games, claiming he was a good luck charm. He encourages the team, saying they will "go all the way." He also mentions that their rivals, the Boston Red Sox, visited him in the Oval Office and subsequently went on a winning streak. A man identified as Randy says they are "changing the luck" by having Trump there. Trump concludes by wishing them luck and shaking hands.
